closed_since: 2026-02-24 (令和8年2月24日) — final day of business, announced on a notice posted at the shop front
name: 粋な一生（いきないっしょう）
address_ja: 東京都台東区台東1-27-2 竹善ビル 1F
cuisine: A twenty-year neighbourhood ramen shokudō doing the three classics — shōyu, shio and miso — with the shio and the miso the ones regulars came for; miso ramen ¥900, butter and corn ¥120 each, sub-¥1,000 bowls. It shut for good on 24 February 2026.
neighborhood: Taitō 1-chōme, on the Taitō-ku side of the Chiyoda boundary — cross Shōwa-dōri from JR Akihabara's Shōwa-dōri exit and walk about 8 minutes toward Ueno (465 m from Akihabara); 8 minutes from Suehirochō (Tokyo Metro Ginza line, exit 1).
hours_raw: 月・火・木・金・土・日 11:00 - 15:00／祝日 11:00 - 20:00／水 定休日　※スープ無くなり次第終了 — these were the hours until the 24 February 2026 closure.
gf_detail: Moot now that the shop is shut, and it would have been 'no' anyway: the whole menu was wheat ramen noodles in shōyu, shio and miso broths, all of which are built on wheat soy sauce or on a miso that is nowhere stated to be rice-only. No gluten-free claim ever appeared on Tabelog or in any coverage.
vegan_detail: No plant-based option. A shokudō ramen counter running animal stock, with chāshū on the standard bowls; the shop closed before any vegan item was ever recorded.

roles: 店主 (owner-chef, unnamed in any published source)
chef_bio.origin: Taitō 1-chōme, Taitō-ku — the shop stood on the far side of Shōwa-dōri from Akihabara, right on the Chiyoda/Taitō boundary
chef_bio.background: 粋な一生 opened on 12 December 2005 and ran for twenty years as an 18-seat ramen shokudō (10 counter, 8 table) under an aged hand-painted sign reading ラーメン食堂「粋な一生」. It reached Tabelog 3.71 and was described locally as one of the shops that defined Akihabara ramen, even though it sat far enough off the station that people crossed Shōwa-dōri specifically for it. The closing notice taped to the door read 「誠に勝手ながら、当店は令和8年2月24日をもちまして閉店することと致しました。これまで20年間、多くのお客様に温かく支えていただき、営業を続けることが出来ました。心より感謝申し上げます。」 No successor shop or relocation has been announced.
chef_bio.specialty: 塩ラーメン and 味噌ラーメン (¥900, butter ¥120 / corn ¥120) were the two bowls regulars named most; a 塩つけ麺 also had a following.

anecdotes.text: The closing notice thanked customers for twenty years: 「これまで20年間、多くのお客様に温かく支えていただき、営業を続けることが出来ました。」
Local reaction was almost entirely about the shio and the miso — 「ここの塩ラーメンと塩つけ麺が好きで、よく食べてたので残念…」 and 「アキバを代表するラーメン店の１つが」.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Tabelog 13021102 is headed 【閉店】粋な一生（いきないっしょう）, files it under 秋葉原/ラーメン・つけ麺, and gives 東京都台東区台東1-27-2 竹善ビル1F, coordinates 35.70165/139.77677, 18 seats, cash only, all non-smoking, an opening date of 2005年12月12日, hours 11:00–15:00 (holidays to 20:00) closed Wednesdays with スープ無くなり次第終了, and a 3.71 rating. The Akihabara local blog ツルミロボBlog (kaztsu.com), posted 20 January 2026, photographs the closure notice and quotes it verbatim: final day 令和8年2月24日, after twenty years. It also prices the miso ramen at ¥900 with ¥120 butter and ¥120 corn toppings.

gf_cross_contamination.text: An 18-seat counter shokudō with a single noodle boiler serving nothing but wheat ramen; no separate preparation was ever claimed.

cultural_comfort.note: Do not send anyone here. 粋な一生 served its last bowl on 24 February 2026 after twenty years, and the notice on the door was a straight closure, not a move — no relocation or successor shop has been announced anywhere. The record should be hidden from the app.

enrich_note: Confirmed as a real Akihabara-area shop and confirmed permanently closed. A nationwide Tabelog keyword search for 粋な一生 (the double-encoded rstLst form that /rst/rstsearch/?sk= redirects to, HTTP 200, 96件) returns exactly one restaurant with the name, 13021102, and its page is already headed 【閉店】. The light record's 塩ラーメン and 秋葉原 both check out — the shop is 465 m from Akihabara's Shōwa-dōri exit, matching the sweep's neighbourhood string, and shio was one of its two signature bowls. The closure date comes from a photograph of the shop's own notice on the Akihabara local blog ツルミロボBlog (20 January 2026): 「令和8年2月24日をもちまして閉店」. Coordinates updated to Tabelog's own (35.701651, 139.776769), about 470 m from the sweep's approximate pin. Status closed_permanently with closed_since set; recommend hiding from the app.
